contract.name: Select
contract.summary: FinCore's native single-value select: label + control + helper/error, four mutually exclusive states, an independent focus ring and only select.* component tokens. Implemented as framework-agnostic CSS with native HTML semantics; no Figma source exists yet.
contract.maturity: implemented; framework-agnostic CSS + native HTML; no Figma source

evidence: Local reconstruction from the feat/select branch reference; the branch contract was minimal and not schema-complete, so this file follows the Input contract shape instead.
The token block was added to tokens/tokens.json and generated into tokens/dist/tokens.css; node tokens/check.mjs --write passed with 27 select.* component tokens.
The stylesheet consumes only variables generated from select.* component tokens.
No Figma component set exists for Select in v0.1, so canonical.figma is null and no design-evidence claims are made.

component: Render the full field anatomy: label, native select control, and a helper/error row.
Apply only select.* component tokens for colour, geometry and typography.
Resolve Disabled > Error > Hover > Default for the control surface and border.
Render the focus ring as an independent overlay when keyboard focus is present, except when disabled.
Expose native select semantics, the native disabled state and the options supplied by the application.
application: Choose the options, write the label and provide the selected value.
Own validation: decide when a value is invalid and what the error says.
Set aria-invalid and connect the error or helper message with aria-describedby.
Use native disabled only when the control is genuinely unavailable.
Own layout width and ensure no surrounding container clips the focus ring.
Never use Select for multi-value, searchable or free-text entry.
figmaOnly: No Figma component set exists for Select in v0.1; there are no design-time properties to translate.

intended: Choosing one value from a known, short set of options such as account type, currency or country.
Form fields where a native select is the most predictable control for assistive technology.

inappropriate.reason: This contract covers a single-value native select only.
inappropriate.alternative: Use a future multi-select or combobox component.

inappropriate.use: Searchable, grouped or virtualised long lists.
inappropriate.reason: Native select does not support search and gives limited control over long option lists.

inappropriate.use: Communicating an error with a red border only.
inappropriate.reason: Colour alone is not an accessible error signal.
inappropriate.alternative: Render an error message in the helper slot alongside aria-invalid.

structure: Field: vertical stack of label, control wrapper and helper/error message.
Label: 14/20, weight 500, select.label.color. Associated with the select via for/id.
Control: 40px high, 1px inside border, 6px radius, 12px horizontal padding, white fill by default.
Focus Ring: absolute sibling overlay, 2px outside stroke, 8px concentric radius, shown on :focus-visible.
Message: 12/16, weight 400, select.helper.color; the error variant uses select.text-error.

literals.reason: Width belongs to layout; no width token exists in v0.1.
No font-family token exists in v0.1; the control inherits the page font.
Removes the platform control chrome so the token-driven border, radius and fill apply.

properties.name: Label
properties.description: Visible label for the control. The default is placeholder copy, not production copy.

production.notes: Must be non-empty. Provide a programmatic label association.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Stable id used for the label association and message references.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Must be unique in the document.
The component does not infer a value from the first option.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Maps to the native disabled attribute.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Do not use disabled as a validation strategy.

codeOnlyProperties.description: When non-empty, sets aria-invalid and replaces helper copy in the message row.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: The application owns the error copy.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Supporting copy shown when there is no error.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Helper and error copy are never stacked.
Validation belongs to onBlur or form submit, not every change.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Native form field name used during submission.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Must be unique within the form.
Add a visible required indication in the application.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Layout-only escape hatch for width and placement.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Must not change colour, typography, radius, height, border, gaps or focus treatment.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Controls the size variant (sm, md, lg).
Applies loading state and sets aria-busy="true".

variants.name: Default
variants.notes: There is no Figma variant set; this single entry records the complete runtime token surface. State is derived in production.

validCombinations.result: White fill, select.border boundary, primary value and normal label/helper; no ring.
select.border-hover boundary; all other Default properties unchanged.
select.border-error boundary and select.text-error message; the message stays visible.
Muted fill, matching disabled border, muted value; label and helper stay legible; no interaction.
Default boundary plus the 2px focus ring at a 2px offset.
Hover boundary plus the focus ring.
Error boundary, error message and focus ring coexist.
Focused is ignored; Disabled wins and no ring appears.
Not modelled. The error border persists with no independent hover border.
Not modelled. Disabled wins; no error border or error-coloured message.

precedence: State precedence: Disabled > Error > Hover > Default.
Focus is orthogonal to State in Default, Hover and Error. Disabled suppresses focus entirely.
Disabled suppresses error treatment and the focus ring.
conflicts: Error + Hover is not modelled. Do not add a hover border on top of the error border.
Disabled + Error is not modelled. Do not show a red border or red message on a disabled control.
Disabled + Focused is not modelled as a visible combination; the ring must be suppressed.
Focus is not a fifth State.
notes: The component has no Figma variant set; the state model is derived from native interaction and the application-owned aria-invalid flag.
The focus ring is an overlay, not a variant.
Validation is owned by the application, not by the component state machine.

tokens.rule: Component code consumes only select.* component tokens. Colour tokens alias Semantic roles; geometry and typography tokens alias Primitives because no semantic geometry layer exists. Never consume a primitive or Semantic token directly, and never hardcode a hex or px value that a token already covers.

dependencies.name: select.background
dependencies.role: Control fill in Default, Hover and Error

dependencies.name: select.helper.font-size
dependencies.role: Helper and error message font size

dependencies.name: select.helper.line-height
dependencies.role: Helper and error message line height

stateMapping.label: select.label.color
stateMapping.notes: The message row carries the error copy and remains visible.

stateMapping.label: select.label.color
stateMapping.notes: Disabled wins over Error, Hover and Focused.

stateMapping.label: select.label.color
stateMapping.notes: Focused is ignored; no ring is rendered.

forbidden: Do not consume color.*, space.*, radius.*, font.* or size.* directly in Select code.
Do not hardcode #FFFFFF, #71717A, #52525B, #DC2626, #991B1B, #E4E4E7, #A1A1AA, #3F3F46, #18181B, 40px, 12px, 6px, 8px, 4px, 1px or 2px when a select.* token exists.
Do not introduce select.success.*, select.warning.*, select.readonly.* or select.icon.* tokens.
Do not reuse input.* or button.* tokens for Select; Select has its own select.* set.
Do not override tokens per instance; theme overrides belong at the token layer.

design.requirement: The control is 40px high, above the 24px minimum target.
design.verification: Measure the rendered control height at 100% zoom.

design.requirement: Focus is a 2px ring at a 2px offset with an 8px concentric radius and at least 3:1 against the adjacent surface.
design.verification: Inspect the overlay geometry and measure select.focus.color on supported surfaces.

design.requirement: Value, label, helper and error text meet 4.5:1 on supported surfaces.
design.verification: Recompute the contrast matrix from resolved token values.

production.requirement: Every select has a programmatic label association, normally <label for> or aria-labelledby. The label text is the accessible name.
production.verification: Assert the computed accessible name and the label/control association.

production.requirement: Error combines aria-invalid, a distinct border and a text message referenced by aria-describedby.
production.verification: Inspect the accessibility tree and grayscale rendering.

production.requirement: Use native disabled rather than aria-disabled so the control leaves the tab order and interaction.
production.verification: Confirm the control cannot be focused or changed while disabled.

contrast.notes: Selected value on the control fill.
Helper copy on the page surface.
Error copy on the page surface.
Control boundary on the page surface.
Hovered boundary on the page surface.
Invalid boundary on the page surface.
Focus ring on the page surface.
Inactive control; WCAG 1.4.3 and 1.4.11 exclude disabled controls.

allowed: Layout-only wrappers for width, grid placement and external spacing.
Additional native attributes such as name, required and aria-* through the application.
forbidden: Overriding select.* colours, typography, radius, height, border or focus treatment per instance.
Replacing the native select with a custom listbox while claiming this contract.
themeOverrides: Theme overrides belong at the token layer and require contrast revalidation.
Any dark or inverse theme must add surface-specific select.* tokens first.

canonical: <label class="fc-select__label" for="account-type">Account type</label> inside .fc-select, with .fc-select__control wrapping the native select.
forbidden: Do not nest a select inside a button or a link.
Do not use Select as a menu or navigation control.

invalidConfigurations.configuration: A select with no label or programmatic name.
invalidConfigurations.why: The control has no accessible name.
invalidConfigurations.correct: Always render a label associated by for/id, or an equivalent aria-labelledby.

invalidConfigurations.configuration: An error shown only as a red border.
invalidConfigurations.why: Colour alone is not an accessible error signal.
invalidConfigurations.correct: Set aria-invalid and render the error message in the message row.

visual.given: Default, Hover, Error and Disabled renders
visual.then: each state uses the matching select.* tokens and no literals.

behaviour.then: the native change event fires and the selected value updates.

accessibility.then: the label text is the accessible name.

tokens.then: every custom property resolves to a select.* component token.

regression.given: keyboard focus on an enabled select
regression.then: the ring renders and it is suppressed when disabled.

limitations.limitation: No Figma component set exists for Select in v0.1.
limitations.impact: There is no design-side verification evidence.
limitations.mitigation: Treat the token block and CSS as the canonical source until a Figma set is published.

limitations.limitation: Only the native single-value select is supported.
limitations.impact: Search, multi-select and rich option rendering are unavailable.
limitations.mitigation: Use a future combobox or multi-select component.

limitations.limitation: Select is not specified for inverse or dark surfaces.
limitations.impact: Placing it on an inverse surface may fail contrast.
limitations.mitigation: Stay on default, canvas, subtle, muted or raised; add surface tokens before supporting inverse.

readOrder: Read this contract, then components/select/select.css, then the select tokens in tokens/tokens.json.
rules: Use only select.* component tokens in Select code.
Keep the native select and the associated label.
Never communicate an error with colour alone.
uncertaintyPolicy: If a required state or token is missing, stop and request a contract update rather than hardcoding a value.
definitionOfDone: The select renders all four states from select.* tokens.
The label association and error message association are present.
The focus ring is visible for keyboard focus and suppressed when disabled.

valid.title: Labelled native select
valid.explanation: Uses the canonical classes, a programmatic label and a native select.

invalid.title: Select without a label
invalid.explanation: The control has no accessible name and is missing the control wrapper.
